plain: A former guard at nuclear missile sites named Mario Woods told podcast host Jesse Michels that in the 2020s he went back to a missile site called November 5, off Orman Road near New Underwood, South Dakota, to film a documentary. He says that, years before, he had a frightening encounter there. He says that when he got out of the vehicle and walked toward the site, a feeling came over him so strong he nearly fell to his knees.
